summary.en: An unstable nucleus can spontaneously decay, emitting radiation; its half-life is the time it takes for half of a sample of that isotope to decay.
summary.et: Ebastabiilne tuum võib iseeneslikult laguneda, kiirgades kiirgust; selle poolestusaeg on aeg, mille jooksul laguneb pool antud isotoobi kogusest.
